title: Revelation 11:1-2 — measure the temple of God; the holy city trampled 42 months
summary: Revelation 11:1-2 quoted in English with Greek book title: John is given a measuring rod and told to measure the temple of God, the altar and the worshipers, but to leave out the outer courtyard, which is given to the nations who trample the holy city for 42 months. The word 'temple' is highlighted in gold.

text.text: 1 Then I was given a measuring rod like a staff and was told, “Go and measure the temple of God and the altar, and count the number of worshipers there.
2 But exclude the courtyard outside the temple. Do not measure it, because it has been given over to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for 42 months.

numbers.note: months the holy city is trampled by the nations
